title: Indivisibility of ray class groups of real quadratic fields
summary: Let ${\ell}$, p $\ge$ 5 be primes such that p | (${\ell}$ -1). Let $Δ$ > 0 be the fundamental discriminant of a real quadratic field in which ${\ell}$ splits. We denote by h - ${\ell}$ ($Δ$) the order of the minus part (for the Galois action) of the ray class group of Q( $\sqrt$ $Δ$) of modulus ${\ell}$. In this paper, we study the indivisibility of h - ${\ell}$ ($Δ$) by p, and prove that under the assumption that this set is non-empty.
